title: Finfluencers, tips and 'guaranteed returns' — how to spot unsafe advice
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: In India, anyone giving personalised investment advice for a fee must be registered with SEBI as an Investment Adviser or Research Analyst, and SEBI has restricted registered entities from associating with unregistered finfluencers. Real investments cannot guarantee returns: any scheme promising fixed high returns such as 2% a day, 30% a month or 'double your money in 6 months' is a red flag for a Ponzi or fraud scheme. Other warning signs: pressure to act today, 'insider tips', screenshots of profits, joining a private Telegram or WhatsApp group, paying to get tips, and being asked to deposit money in a personal account or an unfamiliar app. Before trusting anyone, search their name on the SEBI intermediary list at sebi.gov.in, and never share OTPs or login details. If you have lost money, call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in immediately.
summary_hinglish: Paise lekar personal advice dene wale ko SEBI mein Investment Adviser ya Research Analyst registered hona zaroori hai. Guaranteed return (2% daily, 30% monthly, paisa double) fraud ka sign hai. Urgency, insider tips, private Telegram group, personal account mein paisa jama karne ko kaha jaye to ruk jao. SEBI list mein naam check karo; fraud ho gaya to 1930 par call karo.
summary_hi: पैसे लेकर निजी सलाह देने वाले को SEBI में निवेश सलाहकार या रिसर्च एनालिस्ट के रूप में पंजीकृत होना ज़रूरी है। गारंटीड रिटर्न (रोज़ 2%, महीने में 30%, पैसा दोगुना) धोखाधड़ी का संकेत है। जल्दबाज़ी, इनसाइडर टिप्स, प्राइवेट टेलीग्राम ग्रुप या निजी खाते में पैसा मांगना हो तो रुक जाएं। ठगी हो तो 1930 पर कॉल करें।
